name: Exelixis, Inc.
moat_justification: CABOMETYX has real clinical and brand leadership (47% of the RCC oral TKI basket, 45% NET 2L+ new-patient share) and a defended patent estate (MSN generic barred until Jan 2030), but the franchise is one molecule, its composition-of-matter patent expired Aug 2026, a different-salt rival is already FDA-approved, and ROIC was at/below cost of capital through FY2023 (6.7%) before jumping to 23.6% (FY2024) and 41.0% (FY2025) — a product cycle, not yet a through-cycle franchise. Gross margin ~96% for five straight years.
fragility_flags: STALE_FY: latest fiscal year ended 9 months ago — check TTM/quarterly OE and consider --base-oe-ps override
BUYBACK_TAILWIND: share count shrinking 4.6%/yr — already credited via the growth adjustment
OE_VOLATILE: OE/share range over the last 5 yrs spans >3x — normalized base helps but the business is cyclical; widen bear weight
SHARES_FALLBACK: no diluted share count filed for 2016 — those history years use the basic / outstanding / dei count recorded in the shares_tag column; per-share history there is approximate

DEBT_TAGS_BLANK: no debt tag reports for the latest fiscal year — net debt is UNKNOWN (not zero); no leverage verdict is possible from the engine, state the balance sheet from the filing in analysis.md
BASE_DIVERGENCE: latest FY OE/share 2.71 vs 3-yr median 1.95 — one of them is distorted; find out which and why
TIER_BAND: bear-case tier D (9.2%) vs bull-case tier C (13.9%) — the verdict spans tiers; size any position to the bear end
one_liner: High-quality single-drug cash machine, moat 5/10 — at $62.23 it does not clear 15% (weighted IRR 11.2%, IV@15% $42.37 vs $62.23); clears 15% only at or below $42.37, and the patent cliff means size to the bear case (Tier D).
moat_for: RCC market leadership: 47% of oral TKI prescriptions, still gaining share
Rapid NET uptake: 45% of oral 2L+ new-patient share ~1 year post-approval
Patent estate defended in court: MSN generic barred until at least Jan 15, 2030
Ex-U.S. royalty stream via Ipsen/Takeda on the same molecule
~96% gross margin funding $1.11B of TTM buybacks; debt-free, net cash
moat_against: Single-molecule concentration: cabozantinib is ~91% of revenue
Composition-of-matter patent expired Aug 2026; protection rests on secondary/formulation patents (Feb 2032 patent on trial Nov 2026)
Different-salt cabozantinib (Handa OMCAZIO, 505(b)(2)) FDA-approved Sep 2026, outside the malate estate
Gross-to-net deductions ~30% and rising on 340B utilization
Successor zanzalintinib unapproved and binary (PDUFA Dec 3, 2026); ROIC above cost of capital only since FY2024
